Name: Hu Tao (Project Genshin Farmer Preset) - Fashion Sense (FS) and Farmer Portraits (FP)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3]Play as Hu Tao from Genshin Impact. Commissioned by [i]senpoi[/i] as part of my Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires aedenthorn's framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] and PeacefulEnd's framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to these amazing mod authors!
[/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img][/center]


[size=3]Role play as Hu Tao using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes hairstyle, top, shorts and shoes. 
Hairstyle has a static version, as well as an editable color version.[/size]
[i]You will need to edit skin color and eyes yourself.[/i]

[size=4]Farmer Portraits:[/size]

Portraits made by me (Arknir27).

To use, make sure you only have one type of farmer portraits installed. It will not work if you have Tartaglia or Aether or Zhongli farmer portraits installed (You would need to manually remove the respective "[CP] -Genshin Character- Farmer Portrait" out of your mods folder.)

There are two expressions: "neutral" and "smile"
The config is set to "neutral" by default. After running the game, a config will be generated and you can choose which Zhongli expression you want. Change "neutral" to "smile" if you want the happy expression to show.

Downloads.Description:
Requires latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher. Make sure to have PeacefulEnd's Fashion Sense and aedenthorn's Farmer Portraits installed first.

- Download this mod & unzip all attachments into Stardew Valley/Mods

- Run the game using SMAPI
